scenario: A high-volume generic keyword competes with a lower-volume commercial term tied to the approved conversion.
A one-off SERP check does not show the domain and no query-level GSC row is available.
expectedDecision: Return SEARCH_UNMEASURED, not an out-of-rank claim.

scenario: A successful GSC query reports zero impressions for a URL.
expectedDecision: Keep measured zero separate from indexation status.

scenario: One AI-engine run cites the site.
expectedDecision: Classify the citation as volatile, not stable.
requiredPolicyTokens: One successful citation run is never stable

scenario: Search visibility is strong while AI citation is unmeasured.
expectedDecision: Report independent search and AI axes.

scenario: Current member and event counts conflict across first-party surfaces.
Politeness and suffix variants are supplied as separate AI questions.
expectedDecision: Cluster variants under one canonical target denominator.

scenario: A guide article and service page both receive impressions for the same commercial intent.
expectedDecision: Assign decision and education roles before remediation.

scenario: The AI test sample contains only branded questions.
expectedDecision: Flag a measurement defect and reject overall share claims.

scenario: A dated article contains a publication-time community count.
llms.txt exists but no engine observation has run.
requiredPolicyTokens: never evidence of a mention or citation

scenario: A dashboard is populated only from seed targets.
expectedDecision: Fail a readiness gate that requires measurement imports.

scenario: The upstream event API returns multiple pages.
expectedDecision: Require complete pagination before refresh success.

scenario: Completed, cancelled, upcoming, private, and duplicate event rows are present around a JST date boundary.
expectedDecision: Apply the versioned published-event inclusion rule.

scenario: The upstream statistics API times out.
expectedDecision: Serve a stale last-known-good snapshot without publishing zero.

scenario: A new snapshot is published while a multi-artifact build is running.
expectedDecision: Keep the build pinned to its starting snapshot.
requiredPolicyTokens: Pin one snapshot ID at build start

scenario: A consumer hard-codes the latest member/event totals.
expectedDecision: Fail CI outside named historical fixtures.
requiredPolicyTokens: Current-value literals in consumers fail CI

scenario: Two consumers display equal values sourced from different snapshots.
